title: Bilingual terminology authority (data/src/glossary.yaml)
description: Chinese poker terminology has no standard, so this file is the standard. Docs, generated tables, 13x13 axis labels and CLI output all render from it, which is why a term used in a lesson but absent here fails CI rather than drifting.

abbrev.description: Latin abbreviation. House style: MDF, EV, ICM, SPR stay Latin inside Chinese prose, with the Chinese full name given on first use only.

avoid.description: Rejected synonyms. A lint flags their appearance in docs so the two languages cannot silently disagree about what 防守频率 means.
